# Prince Kumar

Preferred canonical URL: https://princeperspect.in

## Site Purpose

This site is the professional portfolio of Prince Kumar. It presents his work across strategy, product thinking, engineering execution, market research, analytical writing, and AI-enabled product building.

## Author

Prince Kumar is a strategy, product, and engineering practitioner focused on turning ambiguous business and technology problems into structured analysis, product direction, and working systems.

## Expertise

- Strategy and market analysis
- Product management and product thinking
- Software engineering and systems design
- Startup execution and operator workflows
- AI-enabled tools, research, and automation
- Hypothesis-led analytical memos
